published_revisions.note: TC2 ran the commits above before their messages were rewritten for publication; the published commits have identical Git trees.

hardware: NVIDIA A40 on TC2N01; PyTorch 2.11.0+cu128; Python 3.12.15

reproduction.baseline_matches_recorded: cvae_multiscene_pilot: 398/5,952 tracked, selected update 16,000, validation posterior/prior MAE 0.02091/0.02113, KL 0.2741, as in multiscene-validation-checks.json
reproduction.flow_matches_recorded: cvae_flow_pilot: 5,654/5,952 tracked, 80/96 complete clips, validation posterior/prior MAE 0.00429/0.00604
reproduction.checkpoint_file_hashes_differ: Checkpoint files store run paths and provenance, so file hashes differ from the original account even where every metric matches.

diagnostics.force_probe: submission/cvae_force_probe.py: negate the force on nonzero-force validation clips and decode with fixed latents; foreground = true future object masks, scoring only.
diagnostics.motion_timing: submission/cvae_motion_timing.py: track every frame of saved samples; selected/other displacement from frame zero at frames 4, 8, 16 and 31 against simulator references. Run locally on copies of the TC2 dataset and samples.
diagnostics.selection_drift: submission/cvae_selection_drift.py: per-case selected/other displacement, motion along the force, onset frame and minimum centre gap in the force-0.4 selection probe, plus selected-object counts per action from clip metadata. Run locally on copies of the TC2 dataset and samples.

checkpoint_backup: Verified local copies of every best.pt (SHA-256 above) under ignored outputs/tc2-ops/cvae-study; not in Git.
scope: One training seed per configuration; four validation scene groups. No test split was opened. The motion-timing diagnostic reinterprets the 0.5-second action controls but does not replace them.

force_magnitudes_by_action.source: Clip metadata of dataset 03c9468e; magnitudes of force_xy, clip counts. Test splits other than the force_ood metadata are not read.
